clauses.heading: Domestic card processing fee
clauses.text: The processing fee for captured domestic card payments is 1.55% of the gross captured amount through 31 August 2026.

clauses.heading: GST on valid fee
clauses.text: GST is 18% of the valid processing fee and not of an excess fee.

clauses.heading: Permitted deductions
clauses.text: Only expressly listed deductions are permitted; unlisted platform fees are prohibited.

clauses.heading: Settlement timing
clauses.text: Captured payments must be settled within two business days of capture.

clauses.heading: Settlement arithmetic
clauses.text: Settlement and bank credit equal gross less approved fee, valid GST and valid refunds.

clauses.heading: Refund integrity
clauses.text: Refunded principal may be deducted once and no additional refund fee is payable.

clauses.heading: Domestic card fee amendment
clauses.text: Domestic card processing fee is 1.65% for captures on or after 1 September 2026.
